name: Sub-Saharan Africa
note: Sub-Saharan Africa's music ranges from griot epics, court drumming and forest polyphony to guitar-band dance music and some of the world's most influential electronic and pop styles. Rhythm, call-and-response and tonal-language melody link many of its traditions.
